1.consolidated_definition: dep. Ejercicio de flexión de rodilla que fortalece los cuádriceps y los glúteos. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Luego sigue una rutina de jumping jacks, abdominales, squats, lagartijas (push ups). Completado el ciclo, realizan los mismos ejercicios a mayor velocidad
1.en_consolidated_definition: Knee flexion exercise that strengthens the quadriceps and glutes. This is a raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Following this, they perform a routine of jumping jacks, abdominal exercises, squats, and push-ups (lizards). After completing the cycle, they repeat the same exercises at an increased speed.
